accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop as aria-label on the host (default "Loading").
announcements: status role: polite announcement of the label when the spinner is inserted
aria: host: role="status" and aria-label=label, set before the first render
label is also visually hidden text inside the status
decorative: aria-hidden="true" on the host, no role, no label text

antiPatterns.pattern: Spinner for a long task with known progress
antiPatterns.why: People can't tell how long is left

antiPatterns.pattern: Several spinners at once on one screen

useCases.use: sb-spinner with a label that names what is loading
useCases.when: Content or an action is loading and its duration is unknown

useCases.use: Button renders it decorative; Button announces busy

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Visually hidden text inside the status, so the live region has content to announce.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.notes: Inline SVG of Lucide's loader icon, stroked in currentColor.

openQuestions.question: Keep spinning under prefers-reduced-motion?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, slower: it conveys essential state, so it keeps moving (WCAG 2.2.2 allows essential motion) at double duration.

decorative.note: Hides the spinner from assistive technology. Use it when the container already announces busy (e.g. a loading Button).

label.note: Accessible name announced by the status role. Change it to say what is loading.

contract.summary: A small rotating mark that says work is in progress and its end is unknown.

# Plan: Spinner (planning gate)

Status: **approved 2026-11-08** (full implementation plan approved; Spinner added to the slice, SB-0006).

## Scope
`sb-spinner`: Lucide loader icon, 16px, spinning, `role="status"` with a label; `decorative` mode for use inside Button.

## Files (in build order)
| Step | File |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `src/components/spinner/Spinner.stories.ts` |
| 2 | `playwright/tests/spinner/spinner.behavior.spec.ts` (written first, must fail) |
| 3 | `src/components/spinner/Spinner.scss` -> `Spinner.styles.ts` (generated) |
| 4 | `src/components/spinner/Spinner.ts`, `index.ts` |

## Test plan (test-first)
- Default: role status, accessible name "Loading"; custom label changes the name.
- Decorative: no status role, aria-hidden.
- Size 16px from the token; follows `--sb-spinner-size` overrides.
- Animates; under reduced motion still animates with a longer duration.
- Color follows the parent's `color`.
- axe: no violations.

## Accessibility deviations from the references
None (role=status with a label meets the need).

## Open questions
None open (Q1 answered in the contract).
